message: マリア様が見まくってる
Still, it's great that we seem to have gained a reliable ally.
Her face looks a little red to me, though--maybe it's just my imagination.

name: Misa
message: 「Sakura-kun and I are going to look around the area a bit before heading back, so could you go ahead and report to everyone for us?」

name: Shio
message: 「As you wish. Now then, excuse me!」
The moment I call out to her, she plops right down onto the spot as if a taut string had suddenly snapped.

name: Synn
message: 「Misa, are you okay? Did you get hurt somewhere?!」

name: Misa
message: 「Ah, no, I'm fine, really, I'm okay...」

name: Synn
message: 「It doesn't look like nothing, that's why I'm worried.」

name: Synn
message: 「Tell me what's wrong. If anything were to happen to you, Misa, I...」

name: Synn
message: 「I won't understand unless you tell me clearly, Misa...」

name: Synn
message: 「If it really is nothing, then that's fine.」

name: Synn
message: 「Just talk to me properly and put my mind at ease.」

name: Misa
message: 「It felt like you were protecting me, and I thought it was wonderful, or rather...」

name: Misa
message: 「I'm saying you looked cool when you were fighting, Sakura-kun!」

name: Misa
message: 「H-How could I just come right out and say something so embarrassing...」

name: Misa
message: 「That I got so captivated by you, my heart felt all floaty and I couldn't even stand...」

name: Misa
message: 「It's way too embarrassing, there's no way I could say that...!」
With her face bright red, she looks down.
Seeing Misa like that, she looks so unbearably endearing to me...

name: Synn
message: 「How should I put it, I've always been thinking that I had to protect Misa...」

name: Synn
message: 「If I managed to do that, I guess I'm glad.」
Gently, I kneel down beside Misa.
Her bright red face remains downcast.

name: Synn
message: 「Shall we rest at the church for a bit?」

name: Misa
message: 「I just told you I can't stand...」
At least enough to know that I have to do something about it.
As if gently wrapping around Misa's body.

name: Synn
message: 「It's kind of my fault you can't walk anymore, Misa.」

name: Synn
message: 「I'll take responsibility and carry you there.」

name: Synn
message: 「Besides, I can actually see your face properly now.」
She looks down again. Still, she's much closer than before, and it puts me at ease.

name: Synn
message: 「If you want, should we head back to everyone like this?」

name: Misa
message: 「Wh--!? No way, absolutely not! Never in a million years!」

name: Synn
message: 「Ahaha. I'm glad, you seem lively enough.」
Because Misa is flailing her arms and legs, I nearly lose my balance.

name: Synn
message: 「T-That's why I told you not to thrash around...」

name: Synn
message: 「No matter what happens, I won't let go.」

name: Synn
message: 「Looks like you'll feel better if you rest for a bit.」

name: Misa
message: 「I wouldn't make a blunder like that... 」

name: Synn
message: 「You can't stand up right now, though.」
She turns away again, and on top of that, squirms and wriggles around.

name: Synn
message: 「Don't say that, come on, look over here.」
Just as she suddenly turns back around, our lips collide and press together....

name: Misa
message: 「I-It's because your face was so close, Sakura-kun...」

name: Misa
message: 「This was an accident. Just a coincidence, got it!」

name: Synn
message: 「Then I guess it can't be helped if it happens again...」
This time, I'm the one who gently brings my lips closer.
As if being drawn right into Misa in my arms.
Having taken a long time to finally reach the church, we.
At our own pace, slowly rested our bodies...
When we returned to everyone, we apologized just a little for being late.
